rows.name: owning_ring
rows.workload: Four owned-byte clones, four pops and four destructor calls per iteration; allocation/cleanup included.
rows.equivalence_limit: Fresh/empty destinations and identical clone/drop/failure contract; erased storage is actual typed objects, not arbitrary byte buffers.
rows.observer_policy: Seven batches, zero separate warmup. clock() CPU time includes checks/accumulation and can round to zero; mean per iteration is not tail latency or per-operation WCET. No cross-profile or cross-workload universal speed claim.

limits: Original T68-MEASUREMENTS is bound to ten actual contracts and40rubrics, not headings. All original gaps remain as facet records.
Derived rates are arithmetic on retained CPU-time samples, not new executions; storage/process experiments do not establish physical power-cut or bus timing.
Only listed equivalent groups support relative comparisons. Policy changes, parse versus stream, and graph versus filesystem are different workloads.
All13cost dimensions include contract reasoning and source/object evidence; counts or quiet sanitizers do not prove universal bounds.
Published C17/C23 and attempted POSIX2024 pages remain access gaps; no independent reviewer or learner mastery is manufactured.
